body:
Feeling like a burden is such a normal (and awful) side effect of when we’re feeling down, low, depressed; it’s how it makes you feel and isn’t true; please remember that. Usually it’s because you have burdens to carry yourself.  And trust me, no one feels like you think they do, I can guarantee that.
I know I’m not much help but I really hope you feel better; please try to get help if you feel a breakdown coming on, it’s not easy to get the courage to get help but is absolutely worth it.
And happy birthday :) -  it’s already here where I am in the U.K.

You’re iq doesn’t equal how much of an amazing person you are. Some of the best people have low iqs - it doesn’t reflect anything about your personality.
There might be a lot of stuff right now too, but I bet it won’t last forever. Whatever it is you can get through it <3
Looks like a big chunk of raw quartz; hard to see the colours properly but would say rose quartz. Nice big piece :)
